privacyPolicy.heroSubtitle: This Privacy Policy is an integral part of the SatGo User Agreement.

sections.title: General Provisions
sections.body:
SatGo collects and processes only the personal data necessary to operate the platform and provide its services.

By using the platform, users voluntarily agree to the collection and processing of their personal data in accordance with this Policy.

sections.title: Data We Collect
sections.body:
SatGo may collect the following information:

• Account information (name, email address, phone number)
• Listing information and content provided by users
• Communication data exchanged through the platform
• Technical data such as IP address, browser type, device information, and access time

SatGo does not collect or process sensitive personal data such as racial origin, political views, religious beliefs, health data, biometric or genetic information.

sections.title: Purpose of Data Processing
sections.body:
Personal data is processed for the following purposes:

• Operating and maintaining the platform
• Improving platform functionality and user experience
• Preventing fraud, abuse, and unauthorized activity
• Ensuring compliance with applicable laws
• Providing customer support

sections.title: Payment Information
sections.body:
All payments are processed via certified third-party payment providers.

SatGo does not store, process, or have access to users' card details at any time.

sections.title: Data Sharing
sections.body:
SatGo does not sell, rent, or trade users' personal data.

Personal data may only be disclosed:

• If required by law or governmental authorities
• To authorized service providers strictly necessary for platform operation
• With the user's explicit consent

sections.title: Data Security
sections.body:
SatGo implements appropriate technical and organizational measures to protect personal data from unauthorized access, alteration, disclosure, or destruction.

Access to personal data is restricted to authorized personnel only.

sections.title: Data Retention
sections.body:
Personal data is stored only for as long as necessary to fulfill the purposes outlined in this Policy or as required by law.

Users may request deletion of their personal data by contacting support.

sections.title: User Rights
sections.body:
Users have the right to:

• Access their personal data
• Request correction of inaccurate data
• Request deletion of their personal data
• Withdraw consent for data processing

Requests may be submitted via the official contact email.

sections.title: Cookies and Similar Technologies
sections.body:
SatGo may use cookies and similar technologies to:

• Improve website functionality
• Analyze platform performance
• Enhance security

Users may manage cookie preferences through their browser settings.

sections.title: Amendments
sections.body:
SatGo reserves the right to modify this Privacy Policy at any time.

Continued use of the platform after changes constitutes acceptance of the updated Policy.

sections.title: Wallet and Internal Balance
sections.body:
SatGo may provide users with an internal wallet feature that allows users to deposit funds, make payments within the platform, and request withdrawals.

All deposits and withdrawals are processed through certified third-party payment providers. SatGo does not store or have access to users' card details.

Transaction records related to wallet activity may be stored for security, fraud prevention, accounting, and legal compliance purposes.

Users are responsible for ensuring the accuracy of their withdrawal details.

refundPolicy.heroSubtitle: Understand how refunds, cancellations, and buyer protection work on SatGo.

sections.title: Platform Role
sections.body: SatGo acts solely as an intermediary platform between buyers and sellers. SatGo does not sell products and is not a party to sales transactions concluded between users.

sections.title: Private Sales
sections.body:
For private sales conducted through the platform, SatGo does not issue refunds.

Any refund agreements, cancellations, or disputes must be resolved directly between the buyer and the seller.

sections.title: Online Payments and Buyer Protection
sections.body:
For transactions completed through online payment on the platform, buyer protection is provided.

The buyer's payment is temporarily held and released to the seller only after the buyer confirms receipt of the product.

If a dispute or unresolved issue arises before confirmation, the buyer and seller are expected to communicate directly through the platform in order to resolve the matter.

During this period, the funds remain temporarily held until the matter is resolved between the parties.

SatGo does not guarantee product quality, condition, authenticity, or delivery and is not responsible for fulfillment of transactions.

sections.title: Wallet and Deposited Funds
sections.body:
SatGo may provide users with an internal wallet feature to deposit funds, make payments within the platform, and request withdrawals.

Funds deposited into the user wallet are intended solely for use within the platform.

The SatGo wallet does not constitute a bank account, financial institution account, or payment account. Stored balances do not earn interest and are not insured.

Withdrawal requests may be subject to identity verification, security checks, and fraud prevention procedures.

sections.title: Paid Platform Services
sections.body: Payments made for paid platform features, including listing promotions, visibility enhancements, boosts, or other activated services, are non-refundable once the service has been activated.
